user.title: Assist Speaker ID service

hassio_confirm.title: Assist Speaker ID add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Assist Speaker ID add-on found by the Supervisor?

reconfigure.title: Assist Speaker ID service
reconfigure.description: Change the address, ports or API token of the service. People and agent options stay unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the service (Wyoming port or HTTP API).
error.no_asr: The service reports no speech-to-text program - is the upstream ASR server reachable?

people.title: Agent and people
people.description:
Enrolled voices (number of samples): {speakers}.

Link every voice to a Home Assistant person (the fields with names below). The "Agent with speaker" passes requests to the chosen agent and adds a line with the speaker's name to its prompt - {name} is replaced by the name.

data.agent_id: Conversation agent to pass requests to
data.prompt: Line added to the agent's system prompt
data.set_user: Run requests as the speaker's Home Assistant user

data_description.prompt: E.g. "The person speaking is {name}." - only for the "Agent with speaker".
data_description.set_user: The request runs with the permissions of the linked person's Home Assistant user.

thresholds.title: Recognition thresholds
thresholds.description:
The result is the **similarity** of an utterance to a person's voiceprint (0-1; "who is speaking?" says it in percent). A person is recognised when the similarity reaches **their threshold** and beats the runner-up by the **margin**. A higher threshold is stricter: fewer mistakes, more "unknown". Details and calibration: README.

People (samples (recordings) · own threshold, — = shared):
{speakers}

An empty person field = the shared threshold. Calibration with "apply" overwrites the per-person thresholds.

data_description.threshold: For people without an own threshold. Typically 0.5-0.7.
data_description.margin: How much the best person must beat the second one (0.05 = 5 points). Larger for similar voices, e.g. siblings.
data_description.min_speech: Shorter utterances are always "unknown": too little speech to recognise a voice.
data_description.probable_threshold: An unrecognized voice with at least this similarity is reported as "probably <person>" (sensor attributes probable_person and probable_user_id, Assist Router answers "I think it is Anna"). Never runs as that person's user.

abort.thresholds_saved: Saved in the service - effective from the next utterance.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Assist Speaker ID service.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Assist Speaker ID service.

start_enrollment.name: Start enrollment
start_enrollment.description: The next utterances (from any voice satellite) become voice samples of this speaker.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: The satellite asks for each sentence itself (no wake word). Empty = say commands as usual, with the wake word.

add_last_sample.name: Add last utterance
add_last_sample.description: Add the last utterance (at most 10 minutes old) as a sample of this speaker.

delete_speaker.name: Delete speaker
delete_speaker.description: Forgets the person and deletes their voiceprint and recordings.

set_speaker.name: Set speaker
set_speaker.description: Create or rename a speaker, set an own threshold.

list_speakers.name: List speakers
list_speakers.description: Enrolled speakers with their number of samples.

calibrate.name: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Compare every speaker's samples with everybody else's and suggest thresholds.

announce_last.name: Announce the last utterance
announce_last.description: Plays the last utterance - the speaker's own recording, unchanged - on speakers (intercom). By default on every satellite except "exclude".

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: The satellite that recorded the announcement.

preannounce.name: Chime first
preannounce.description: A short chime before the recording.

prefer_players.name: Players first
prefer_players.description: One speaker per room: the media player (e.g. a HomePod) when available, otherwise the satellite. The announcing room gets nothing.

max_age.name: Maximum recording age
max_age.description: An older last utterance is not announced.

reset_speaker.name: Reset speaker
reset_speaker.description: Deletes all voice samples and their recordings of this person (and their own threshold), keeps the person - enrollment starts over.

rebuild_voiceprints.name: Rebuild voiceprints
rebuild_voiceprints.description: Computes every sample again from its saved recording (e.g. after changing the model). Samples without a recording keep their voiceprint.
